audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart is wrong in five of seven rows and contradicts its own why-text. Both layers give Neeko Levels 1-2 (3/10 to Garen) and call Level 3 and Level 6 skill windows, while the whys say 'Q silence shuts off her only combat spell at 1 and your spin out-trades her', 'you keep chunking her', 'the full Q-E combo overwhelms her thin health bar' and 'At 6 the all-in is yours'. First item is marked Garen while its why calls it the skill window.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Skill, Garen] at a 57.4% Garen win rate over 1467 games. Neeko has no early sustain and no escape before Pop Blossom; Garen's Q silence denies Blooming Burst and Tangle-Barbs outright. The only genuinely even stage is First item, where Pop Blossom plus a landed root can flip a fight.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Garen 7/10, Garen 7/10, Garen 6/10, Garen 6.5/10, Garen 6/10, Skill 5/10, Garen 6/10 — matching the packet and the existing whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs is quoted at a 10s cooldown, and nothing states that Inherent Glamour hides the Pop Blossom wind-up.
audit.why: Riot data: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — 10s is rank 5, not the laning number. Pop Blossom's own text says 'The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised', and Neeko's disguise breaks on immobilising CC, on casting a damaging spell, or on taking damage equal to the disguise's health — so a facechecked 'minion' is the real ult threat.
audit.corrected: 12s at rank 1 for the root; treat a disguised Neeko as a hidden Pop Blossom wind-up.

audit.why: Garen wins the lane from level 1 through the sidelane 1v1; the only even stretch is the first-item window where Pop Blossom plus a root can trade back. early/mid/late prose already says this.

edits.before: Track Neeko’s Tangle-Barbs (10s): Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs (12s at rank 1) roots, and grows through each champion it passes. Step up while it is on cooldown.

edits.before: Bleed HP chasing his kite. Spin into a freeze you can't reach. All-in without Q move speed up. And keep the ultimate holstered until a kill is actually on the table.
edits.after: Bleed HP chasing her kite. Facecheck a stray 'minion' — her disguise hides the Pop Blossom wind-up. All-in without Q move speed up. Keep the ultimate holstered until a kill is real.

edits.before: Track his Neeko Neeko root coils, clone trickster, and pop blossom R before you commit
edits.after: Track Tangle-Barbs (12s at rank 1); her root is the one spell that punishes you
